title: Mit Luftdruckgewehr auf Passanten geschossen – Tatverdächtiger vorläufig festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: In the early hours, a man was hit by an air rifle pellet on Falkenseer Damm in Spandau and suffered a superficial skin injury. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested in a nearby flat, where police seized an air rifle, a blank pistol, a butterfly knife and an axe.
